card.name: The word main as in principal
card.fires_on: The word "main", usually after "the" or "a", meaning principal (main article, main focus, main subject). Also "land" in "Mainland" and "page" in "home page".

modes.label: Main as principal
modes.description: The adjective "main" after "the" or "a" before a noun such as focus, subject, forum or ingredient.
modes.example: Life in our towns in the Middle Ages is the<< main>> subject of our work.

modes.label: Main-related compounds
modes.description: The second part of a compound built on "main", such as mainland or home page.
modes.example: Main<<land>> of the Ocean Sea), divided into eight

card.plain: It lights up on the word "main" when it means the chief or principal thing.
